other_conditions: Applicant must be a specially‑abled person as per the Persons with Disabilities Act, 1995 with a minimum disability of 40% or more
Applicant must not have availed benefits under any other self‑employment subsidy scheme such as “Kiyosk Yojana”
Applicant must not have any overdue loans from banks, cooperative societies, or government institutions
Applicant must possess a valid disability certificate and passbook
benefits_summary: Up to ₹5,00,000 loan with a subsidy of up to 50% (maximum ₹50,000) for self‑employment.
